role: Development-guided refinement, not blind final testing
initial_ancestry: Continues four-class expanded_transition_balancing_v6 best950. Original ancestry baseline39 with publishedPAT LRhead; no20_29gradient training. PublicPAT exposure unknown.
augmentation: Native512 crop, paired rotations/flips, gain0.8-1.2. No resizing/gamma/blur.
batch: 6fields:2COL0rulemixed,1oldmixed,1oldP/Ealternating,1LR,1explicitBG. Per-field class-balancedCE+.5Dice, weight.5forrule-labelledfields,1otherwise. Mixed crops retry12times toretain>=512pixels eachP/E.
selection: Highest raw development mean Periderm/Endoderm IoU; score every50updates. Save full trace and never represent as an independent test. No forced left/right boundary.
target_for_success_on_this_crop: Both tissue recalls>=.85, both tissue precisions>=.85, labelled Background recall>=.98, tissue meanIoU>=.75. Even passing is not validation on hundreds of images.
class_support: 14 earlier roots have saved P/E labels; 6 COL0 roots have archived P plus derived interior teaching strips. Root3 has a versioned class correction based on detailed expert transition review. Contours are not all independently pixel-verified.
comparison_policy: Same v6 initial weights, 1200-step budget, seed1611, mild augmentation and optimizer as v7. Data changed: corrected four overlapping root3 patch copies and added one expert-T-centred patch. This also changes crop sampling; not a pure label-only causal experiment.
other_outputs_preserved: No default-model replacement; keep v7 and earlier results.
